answer: Commit a work receipt, wait one round, reveal it. The hash binds agent, task and nonce, so a copied receipt collides and forfeits the vault behind it. Auditors rotate from a pool each epoch and read the receipt through a prism of separate keys, never the identity itself. One precise detail: a duplicate reveal costs the poster more than the reward it tried to double, and an island of clones cannot push one receipt through two accounts.
